task:
Upgrade worker node 'node01' to match the control plane Kubernetes version.

Context: The control plane is already on v1.31.0. node01 is on an older version.
You have SSH access to node01.

On the CONTROL PLANE — drain node01:
  kubectl drain node01 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data

On NODE01 (SSH in: ssh node01) — upgrade kubeadm, kubelet, kubectl:
  # Unhold packages
  apt-mark unhold kubeadm kubelet kubectl

  # Install matching versions
  apt-get update
  apt-get install -y kubeadm=1.31.0-1.1 kubelet=1.31.0-1.1 kubectl=1.31.0-1.1

  # Re-hold
  apt-mark hold kubeadm kubelet kubectl

  # Apply node upgrade
  kubeadm upgrade node

  # Restart kubelet
  systemctl daemon-reload
  systemctl restart kubelet

On the CONTROL PLANE — uncordon node01:
  kubectl uncordon node01

Verify:
  kubectl get nodes
  # All nodes should show v1.31.0 and STATUS=Ready
hints: Always drain the worker node from the control plane before upgrading it
Use apt-cache madison kubeadm to find exact available versions
Run kubeadm upgrade node (not apply) on worker nodes
Uncordon after upgrade to allow scheduling again
